title: Adaptive Multi-Zone Analytics Mirrorset and Residency Gate
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build an adaptive mirrorset layer for analytics events that enforces per-tenant residency constraints while minimizing cross-region amplification and preserving low read/write latency for Console backends. This ticket implements a Residency Gate service that: (1) annotates incoming usage events with tenant residency tags, (2) decides mirror targets for each event based on policy, capacity and cost windows, and (3) emits replication directives to the analytics pipeline (Kafka/CDC) with provenance headers for auditing.
acceptance_criteria: Residency Gate service deployed behind existing ingest LBs and processes 50k events/s in a staging cluster under realistic load tests
Per-tenant residency policies (region allowlist + legal hold flags) are respected: no event is mirrored to disallowed regions
Mirrorset routing decisions recorded to audit log with tenant_id, decision_reason, and applied_policy_version
End-to-end latency added by Gate & mirror orchestration stays under 20ms p50 and 80ms p95 for staged traffic
Automated test harness validates fallback behaviour when a region is unavailable (graceful degrade to approved fallback regions or quarantine)
technical_notes: Design: stateless Gate service with local policy cache + periodic sync from config-manager; decisions emitted as enriched events downstream (kafka topic: analytics.route.decisions)
Policy model: allowlist + preferred_order + quarantine_on_legal_hold. Policies stored in Postgres with per-tenant versioning; ACLs protected via service-to-service mTLS
Routing algorithm: capacity-aware weighted mirrorset selection. Use approximate capacity scores from capacity-metrics service (recent 60s window) and cost weightings per region
Optimization: prefix-based early-local routing for heavy tenants to avoid unnecessary fanout. Maintain in-memory bloom filters for tenant hot-path detection to short-circuit cross-region checks
Data masking: before crossing into regions with stricter PII restrictions, redact fields according to tenant field-level redaction config
Observability: emit metrics: gate.decision.count, gate.decision.latency_ms, gate.fanout_size, gate.audit_failure_count. Traces must include tenant_id and request_id tags
Failure modes: if config-store unreachable, Gate falls back to last-known policy; if capacity scores stale >2m, prefer local-only mirrors and raise alarm
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Deploy Gate service to staging realm with traffic shadowing of production ingest for 2 weeks and run validation harness (load + policy tests). Phase 2: Canary rollout to 5% of production traffic for low-risk tenants (no legal holds) and monitor p50/p95 latencies and audit completeness. Phase 3: Gradual increase with tenant opt-in for cross-region mirror exceptions. Full rollout gated on SLOs and security sign-off.
test_plan: Unit tests for policy evaluation matrix, integration tests using a local Kafka cluster to assert routing headers, chaos injection tests to simulate region outage and SLO regression, end-to-end replay using archived production traces (anonymized) against staging Gate. Performance tests to validate 50k eps with mixed tenant cardinality.
